Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

TOP 1.1.0

Build and native-code reliability

  • Modernized 145 legacy C function definitions for C23-compatible compilers.
  • Registered all native routines and disabled dynamic symbol lookup.
  • Replaced native exit(1) calls with R errors and routed native output through the R console.

User interface

  • Added the validated top_fit() interface and top_model print, summary, coefficient, and covariance methods.
  • Added top_fit_custom() for scientifically defined second-stage designs.
  • Added reusable top_score_support(), batch-friendly top_score_scan(), and detailed top_followup() workflows.
  • Added top_meta() for score-statistic meta-analysis across any number of studies; ScoreMetaAnalysis() remains backward compatible.
  • Added stable names to the legacy model result components.
  • Invalid control tumor coding now raises an error instead of returning text.

Testing and documentation

  • Replaced environment-specific analysis scripts with reproducible testthat tests while preserving the original scripts under legacy/tests.
  • Added R CMD check CI for Linux, macOS, and Windows on devel, release, and old-release R.
  • Added a pkgdown site workflow, four focused vignettes, GitHub issue forms, contribution guidance, citation metadata, a runnable README quick start, dataset documentation, and synchronized function documentation.
